How much does Allo cost, and what's included?

Allo offers three per-seat plans, billed monthly or yearly. Solo is CA$14 a seat a month for one person billed yearly (or CA$19 monthly). Business is CA$45 a seat a month billed yearly (or CA$59 monthly). Ultra is CA$100 a seat a month billed yearly (or CA$120 monthly). Every paid plan includes AI call transcription, AI summaries and native CRM sync (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio and more) at no extra cost, plus a business phone number, free porting of existing numbers and unlimited national calls. Two add-ons are billed on top: the AI Receptionist, at CA$45 a month per agent billed yearly, and the Power Dialer, at $50 a month for the whole team. Outbound SMS to US numbers is included on Business and Ultra, at no extra cost; sending elsewhere uses credits, with $5 of credit included per seat per month. Allo has no setup fees and no contracts, and includes a 7-day free trial.
Per seat, per month, billed monthly or yearly. Solo is one seat. On Business and Ultra you add seats when your team grows, and you only pay for the seats you use, with no setup fees.
Is Allo right for a team our size?

Allo is built for teams under 250 people, the businesses other phone systems treat as their smallest accounts. Solo is for one person. Business fits most teams, from 2 people up. Ultra adds hands-on, personalized support: a dedicated account manager, Slack support, custom onboarding and an SLA. If you have more than 250 people on the phones, talk to us and we'll tell you honestly whether Allo fits.
Is AI included, or is it a paid add-on?

Both, depending on which part. AI transcription, AI summaries, AI call tags and native CRM sync are included in every paid plan at no extra cost. Two modules are billed on top: the AI Receptionist is $32 a month per agent, and the Power Dialer is a flat $50 a month for the whole team. You turn either on from inside Allo once you are on a paid plan.
What add-ons are there, and what do they cost?

Three today, and they work on any plan. The AI Receptionist costs the same as a Business seat and follows your annual or monthly billing. The Power Dialer is a flat $50 a month for the whole team. An extra phone number starts at $5 a month. Healthcare teams that need a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement add $50 a month per workspace.

Receiving texts is unlimited on every plan, at no cost. Sending to US numbers is included on Business and Ultra, at no extra cost. Sending elsewhere uses SMS credits, billed by destination. Business and Ultra include $5 of credit per seat per month, then you pay as you go. Sending to US and Canadian numbers also needs a one-time A2P 10DLC registration, which costs $24. Per-country rates and how a message is counted are on our SMS pricing page.
Both, on every plan: yearly billing costs less per month. You can switch billing or plan whenever you want.
Are there setup fees or contracts?
No setup fees and no contracts. You pay only for what you use and can upgrade, downgrade or cancel anytime, with no lock-in.
What happens when I add or remove seats?
You're billed per seat. Add or remove team members whenever you need, and changes are prorated, so you never pay for seats you don't use.
Do I have to talk to sales to start?
No. Business starts in minutes, straight from the app, and Solo will too when it opens: join the waitlist on its card. Ultra and larger migrations get a dedicated onboarding when you contact sales.
How hard is it to switch from my current phone system?

Most teams take their first calls on Allo the same day. Setup is guided and needs no technical skills. You can start on a new number right away while your current numbers port over for free, and your current line keeps working until the switch, so there is no downtime.
Is keeping my current number an extra cost?

No. We port your existing numbers for free. Porting takes a few business days and your current line keeps working the whole time. A brand-new number is instant in 80+ countries, so most teams start on a new number the same day and switch once the port completes.
